title: Update order: Human.update vs the input processor, for the Arisen and a played Mage pawn (DPC 0.9.177-dev4)
intro: No hands. The Arisen swings for a few seconds with the order probe on; then the first Mage / Sorcerer pawn is taken and chants with the probe on.

probes.who: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.state.active and ('playing '..tostring(D.state.pawn_name)) or 'Arisen') or ''
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors

steps.text: 3/4 Mage pawn chants (chant_test), order probe on during the first chant
